page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head and page number at the top; margin note in the right margin beside "Unde audacter loquitur Massa"; catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: filium hoc fuit Theodorici. Gothorum regis. Illud, inquit, præterea vos credimus admonendos, ut non in vos, sed in hostem sævire cupiatis. Et post: Imitamini certe Gothos nostros, qui foris prælia, intus norunt exercere modestiam.
Ante Theodoricum ejus moniti illustre exemplum sug-gessit nobis Caesar de bello Gallico.

p.i: & ad magistratus autem, & Principes spectat vindicare civium injurias, præsertim eorum fidem implorantium. Quod nisi faciat Princeps, est in culpâ: sive is, qui injuriam intulit, in ejus sit ditione, ac potestate, sive sit externus.

Ergo, inquit, si Princeps, cujus subditus est injuriam passus, convenienter requisitus non curet officii sui partes interponere, tacite quodammodo significans sibi placere, ut inter se armis decernant, is quidem jam non amplius Princeps vocandus

page.notes: Printed "fævire" and "præterea" are hard to read exactly; transcribed as the most likely letters. The "3" in the page number is worn but reads as 323. The catchword "erit," and gathering signature "O 6" are placed in the bottom margin. Faint stains and a watermark at lower right are not transcribed.
